description: This waterfall is located in Maracas Valley (St. Joseph) and features several deep river pools and a small upstream waterfall. It is well-known for a smooth rock face that facilitates sliding down into the main pool. Listed opening hours: 24 HOURS. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
